architecture.summary: Documents only: the SO-12 release record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s2-release.md records the release of main 9655378d (the merge of #333, 'Ask for the email on step 1 of free access and say when the account exists') to production on 3 November 2026 as step 13. Section 1.2 gets the new candidate in its table and a candidate-change paragraph of 3 November 2026 (the 14 changed source files are control plane code; the tenant role does not change; no migration was added), section 5 step 4 names sha256:5d187664... as the rollback image and shifts the older images down, section 6 item 14 names the digests to keep at the GHCR pruning, and section 7 gets three rows. Production is uniform on the released image, and nothing stays open. Every fact comes from the session that made the release. No source, test, configuration, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes; the production architecture is unchanged.
